adjudication.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action calls this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...) but has no .catch handler. popupAjaxError is imported and used for save() failures, so a failed DELETE request would not surface an error to the user and the row would remain until refresh, matching the finding.
